title: Fail SCHC floor restore when rebased hold-down deadline overflows
description: Correctness review of the restart-safe SCHC floor fix found restore_receiver_floor uses now_ms.saturating_add(hold_down). At now_ms near u64::MAX this produces until_ms <= now_ms, so the restored tombstone can expire immediately instead of enforcing a full hold-down. Use checked_add and reject before consuming/mutating persistent state; test the overflow boundary.
